label: models/fw_pipejunction.mdl: two pipes meeting at a flanged elbow, bolted

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_hgun.mdl, models/w_suit.mdl, models/w_oxygen.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, B, D, D where the asset was C, A, A, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline matches the brief's words. A vertical pipe rises from a flanged elbow, the elbow turns through 90 degrees (left and right views), and a horizontal pipe runs off it to a flange plate at the joint. No part is missing or sticks out in any of the ten views.

M2.reason: The brief gives no size for the pipe junction, so there is no size to be within 15% of. The measured 49.5 x 18.1 x 56 units is a plausible scale beside Half-Life's own props, and nothing in the views reads as out of scale.

M3.reason: Parts the brief names, checked down to the small ones: (1) vertical pipe, present; (2) horizontal pipe, present; (3) flanged elbow, present with a flange at its top and at the joint plate to the horizontal pipe; (4) bolts round the flanges, present as small light squares (front, top, back-left views). The brief sets no count of bolts or sides, so no side count applies. The extra foot bracket on the horizontal pipe's far end is not asked for and adds nothing wrong.

M4.reason: Against the brief's rusted steel: blue-grey pipes with orange-brown rust streaks and brown-rust flanges. Each region has one consistent material, and nothing reads as a wrong colour for the place.

M5.reason: Rust streaking on the pipes, flange seams and bolt heads are all there and sharp enough at the lineup scale. The brief asks for no specific markings on this prop, so nothing is missing.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the rule for this prop. In the line-up the asset was never picked as the non-Valve model (0 of 4 readings; the judges picked B and D, which are Valve's). Beside the three of Half-Life's own, it reads as a game prop.

M7.reason: The brief sets no facing. The vertical pipe stands upright and the elbow and the horizontal pipe's foot bracket rest at the bottom of the model, so it stands on its base.

M8.reason: SMAK's check passes with no errors (checkErrors empty). 412 triangles is under Half-Life's most for a prop of this kind and size (439), so it is inside the bound. The top and the horizontal pipe's end read as closed. The elbow's bore shows as a dark hollow from the FRONT view, which is what an open pipe end looks like, not a hole in the model, so it is not charged.
